title: Analysis scripts for: [MANUSCRIPT TITLE]
description: R scripts used to analyse nasal swab metatranscriptomes (viruses, bacteria and host transcriptome) from pre-weaned dairy calves in New South Wales, Australia: PERMANOVA, hurdle mixed models, host differential expression (limma-voom), host-taxon correlation networks, gene annotation and figures. Raw reads: NCBI BioProject PRJNA1191164.
